content: Iesu a On Taitain
On gibunai, Iesu on Galilee tafanam amonai ibib; On men igogoi Judea tafanam amonai itabib yabin Jew babadis nan on si’gogoi sitasubun mes.
Jew yangan asi Guwi An Forag an ra ibiufin,
on mes Iesu taitain on On aurin siyau, “Om atonio efan on unikirir ato unan au Judea tafanamai nan onai Om am bobo efofour on am baigibubunuotis min sinitem.
Iyai iyafan egogoi an bobo wasai inafour sabu sinitai on, on bobo men bubuniai inafour mes. Om atonio osi bobo efofour nono on, uniyamai sabu engon tutufin tafanamai sinsagobim.”
(On taitain mat on men meyan situtumai on.)
Iesu on osi auris iyau, “Yau au wera bag on men inat on. Wera fufur on engon omi ami wera wat.
Sabu tafanamai on men omi sinisisiweiim on, baise osi Yau sebisisiweiiu, yabin Yau nana awures osi asi eta mamaba sefofour on komasin.
Omi wonan forag aurin. Yau on men anan atonio forag aurin on yabin Yau au wera bag on men inat auriu on.”
On atonio dura ikakafun ato On ra fani nana Galilee tafanamai ima.
Iesu Inai Guwi an Forag aurin
On taitain sinai forag aurin weie Iesu on gibui inai, baise On men rerebai inai on, ab On bubuniai inai.
Jew babadis on forag amonai on On sinunuen. Osi sitetem siyau, “On menan nan i?”
Sabu sigaraba kuayo gagamin amonai nan on tous wat sibidurusof bonen. Sabu fani on si’yau, “On Orot obin,” ato sabu fani on si’yau, “Ambin,” ato sabu fani on si’yau, “On sabu ekukuyoyois.”
Baise men iyafan tani On aurin on dura wasai ikakafun mes yabin osi on Jew babadis auris siber.
Forag inai ibabasun, ato on amonai on Iesu inai au tafaror goa nan ibosuruf sabu ibibebeyis.
Jew babadis on men sunub siduduran ato siyau, “Atonio Orot on men inai igayam on, ato On mamaba mes isagob kwakwan i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Yau aifan abibebe on men Yau Tou au baibebe on, baise God emon enat, On Yau ibiyafareu on.
Iyai iyafan egogoi God angogoi nanaba infofour on, arimon insagob Yau atonio abibebe on God emon enat o Yau Tou au baibadai nan dura abikakafun.

Iyai iyafan toun an baibadai dura ebikakafun on efofourtobon toun wabin inbogaiai aurin. Baise on iyafan egogoi ato Iyafan ibiyafarai On Wabin inbogagaiai on, on orot aurin on dura maiauin, on aurin on men baisigo tani yen mes.
Moses on dura bag Baifafaro dura item. Baise omi men iyafan tani Baifafaro dura aurin ifonabo on. Omi aibo mes wofofourtobon Yau wonasubuniu mes i?”
Sabu kuayo gagamin on On siyafotai siyau, “Om dau tefamui emama! Iyafan efofourtobon Om inasubunim mes i?”
Iesu iyafotes iyau, “Yau bobo buburin gagamin kaitamom afour on, ato omi engon tutufin woiduduran.
Yabin Moses on askibubu an baifafaro item nanatum orot wotiaskibubues mes (ato on men Moses askibubu item on, baise omi wawam agirim on sibosuruf), on mes omi on fifi Sabat ra nan wobiaskibubuai.
Omi fifi Sabat ra nan wobiaskibubuai onai omi on men Moses an Baifafaro dura wastob on, ato omi on aibo mes Yau auriu wobiyatatab, yabin Yau orot Sabat ra nan aiyawasai on fasinai i?
Omi men sawar an itinai nan wonitai wonigurubabanai mes, baise omi yawas totorinai nan wonigurubabanen.”
On Min Keriso I?
Sabu fani Jerusalem simama on siyau, “Atonio Orot on babadis sefofourtobon sinasubun mes.
Woit! On wasai nan dura ebikakafun ato osi men On an dura tani sebigaraminai on! Omi wononosin babadis on dura bag sisagob On min Keriso i?
Baise Keriso innanat on men iyafan tani arimon insagob On men emon inat. Ato ot engon tasagob atonio Orot on men emon inat.”

Iesu on nana tafaror goa amonai sabu ibibebeyes ato fonan gagaminai iyau, “Omi min dura bag Yau wosagobiu a omi wosagob Yau on men emon anat i? Baise Yau men Tou au baibadai anat on. Baise On Iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on dura maiauin. Omi On men wosagobai on,
baise Yau On asagobai, yabin Yau On emon anat a On Yau iyafareu.”
Namon osi sifourtobon sitfatumai mes baise men iyafan tani iman On usinai iyein, yabin On an rabob an wera on men inat on.
Baise sabu sigaraba kuayo amonai on On situtumai ato siyau, “Keriso innanat on arimon bobo buburis sigaraba infouren, men atonio Orot bobo ifofouren ba?”
Jew Babadis on Tafanam an Baifafaro Kaifarotis Siyafares Sinai Iesu Sitfatumai mes

Pharisee yangan on sitatam sabu kuayo on atonio osi bobo auris on Iesu aurin sibidurusof, on mes osi Pharisee yangan a priest aiwabis on sabu tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis siyafares sinai On sitfatumai mes.
Iesu iyau, “Yau arimon kafakakai weromin mat tanama ato iyafan Yau ibiyafareu on aurin anan.
Omi arimon Yau wonnueniu baise omi arimon men wongatureu on, yabin Yau on efanai anmama nan on omi men fofonim wonnat on.”
Jew babadis tous amosi siyau bonen, “On efan menan inan on ot men tangaturai i? On arimon inan Greek mafam gagamis ato Jew sabu semama nan, ato nan Greek yangan inibebeyes i?
On ebikakafun yau, ot arimon On tannuen, ato men tangaturai on a On efan menan enan on ot men fofonit tanan on. On an dura yabis on abifan i?”
Sareu Dogu emon Egeg Yawas Ebitet
Forag ra an kanfoun on ra gagamin bag, on ra nan on Iesu imisir ato fonan gagaminai iyau, “Iyai iyafan anjon sareu eteteinin on innat Yau auriu ato sareu intoman.
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, ‘Iyai iyafan Yau ebitutumeu on, sareu dogu emon egeg yawas ebitem on arimon on nunuanai indebur insur.’”

Iesu atonio dura ibikakafun on God an Ayu aurin ikakafun, osi sabu iyabon On sinbitutumai on arimon God an Ayu sinboai. On an werai on Ayu on men sitem on, yabin Iesu on men imatabir men igai au safam sifourai inat God ba imatar on.
Sabu Sanasi Kuseseb Imatar
Sabu sigaraba on kuayo amonai On an dura ibikakafun sitatam ato siyau, “Atonio Orot on dura bag aubairuruotin!”
Sabu fani siyau, “On on Keriso!” Baise sabu fani siyau, “Keriso on men Galilee tafanam emon innat on!
God an dura buk amonai sigayam siyau, Keriso on arimon aiwab David an warar emon innat ato arimon Bethlehem nan inarat, mafam gagamin menan David imama nan.”
Iesu fasinai on mes sabu kuayo sanasi on kuseseb imatar.
Sabu fani on sigogoi Iesu sitfatumai mes baise men iyafan tani iman On usinai iyein on.
Jew Babadis on Iesu Men Situtumai
Tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis simatabir men sinai ato priest aiwabis a Pharisee yangan on sitetemis siyau, “Omi aibo mes On men wobo wonat i?”
Tafanam an baifafaro kaifarotis on siyau, “Atonio Orot dura ibikakafun on men iyafan tani ainau dura ibikakafun ba!”
Pharisee yangan on sitetemis siyau, “On totor omi mat isigoem?
Omi min wosagob babadis tani o Pharisee tani on itutumai i?
Atonio osi sabu kuayo on Moses an Baifafaro dura on men sisagob, on mes osi on God inaudabis!”
Pharisee tani nan imama wabin Nicodemus; on orot on ainau inai Iesu aurin. On osi babadis fani auris iyau,
“Ot ati baifafaro dura iyau nanaba Orot men tanimakiai on, ab ainau an dura tantatam a tansagob On abi bobo ifour.”
Osi siyafotai siyau, “Om mat min Galilee tafanam emon unat i? God an dura buk amonai sigayam on eiyab ato om arimon unsagob on, men aubairuruotin tani on Galilee tafanam emon inat on.”
(Namon osi engon sinai au go.)
